subject: best way to run scantwo permutations?

messages.author: 16a92d7970af7763
messages.subject: best way to run scantwo permutations?
parts:
What is the best way to run scantwo permutations on an HPC with multiple nodes (by node I mean a unit with a set number of threads)?  Is there an easy way to send the permutations for each phenotype to a separate node?  I know you can set n.cluster within each node which is great, but with lots of phenotypes to run, what is the best way to utilize more than one node?  Can we use MPI, mcapply, or batch across nodes?  This page overwhelms me: http://cran.r-project.org/web/views/HighPerformanceComputing.html
Thanks for any tips!

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] best way to run scantwo permutations?
parts:
We haven't implemented anything to assist with parallelizing across multiple nodes.
Functions that take n.cluster will use the multiple CPUs within a node, but not go across nodes.
Partly that's because different cluster setups tend to be so different.

Personally, I use a (now very old) perl script that generates a set of R scripts, one for each node, and then send those R scripts running separately.

karl
